nodes.label: GM PWA App Icon (192x192)
nodes.description: PWA home-screen icon 192×192px for the GeneralModern warehouse/inventory management application. Depicts the initials 'GM' in a bold, serif-style gold typeface centred on a dark navy background, surrounded by an incomplete golden circular arc (open at the top-right). The overall aesthetic is minimalist, premium and luxury-leaning — echoing a high-end brand monogram. Primary colors: deep navy (#0d1a2e approx) background and metallic gold (#c9a030 approx) lettering and arc ring. The icon communicates professionalism, authority and a modern business-management identity suitable for the generalmodern.uz SaaS platform.
